origen: Generación original y pulido con IA; rediseño solicitado expresamente por el usuario.
promptInicial: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final production app logo and Windows app icon for a Spanish prompt-writing tool named Sin Rodeos. Create ONE exceptionally clean, polished, original vector-style symbol, no wordmark and no text. The symbol is a bold geometric ribbon forming a recognizable angular letter S, whose final stroke resolves naturally into a short decisive arrow pointing right. The S and arrow are one coherent compact silhouette, not separate objects. This conveys turning an unclear request into a clear instruction. Optically balanced and legible at 24-48 pixels. Solid icy blue #60A5FA emblem on a deep ink navy #182337 rounded-square app tile; optional very small off-white negative-space accent only if needed for readability. Flat fills, mathematically clean edges, consistent geometry, ample open counters, confident proportions. The tile fills roughly 94 percent of the square canvas, centered, with genuinely transparent pixels outside its softly rounded corners. The emblem fills roughly 70 percent of the tile and is centered optically. Front-on 2D actual logo, not a mockup, presentation board or photograph. Avoid gradients, purple, sparkles, stars, spirals, complex linework, tiny details, 3D, bevels, glow, shadows, glass, textures, extra symbols, words, watermark or white background. The final asset must be a usable square transparent PNG logo.
promptPulido: Polish this exact app logo for production. Preserve the existing S-and-right-arrow silhouette, its precise placement, scale, blue color identity, the navy rounded-square tile geometry, and real alpha transparency outside the rounded tile. Change only the surface finish: make the navy tile a perfectly uniform solid #182337 fill and the blue emblem a perfectly uniform solid #60A5FA fill, with clean anti-aliased edges. Remove ALL faint black scribbles or embossed-looking marks on the left side of the tile. Absolutely no texture, noise, gradients, shadows, bevels, glow, text or watermark. Do not add shapes. The result must be this same logo as clean flat fills on a transparent square PNG.
decisiones: S geométrica con flecha hacia la derecha, azul sobre baldosa azul tinta, sin texto. Transparencia exterior. Fuente de las variantes PNG e ICO. logo.webp se conserva solo como recurso anterior.
